blocks.text: Over 2,000 leaders and professionals from marketing, business, technology, and media gathered at the Manila Marriott Hotel for the opening of DigiCon 2026, spotlighting the growing importance of cross-industry collaboration in driving the Philippines’ digital future. Organized by the Digital Marketing Association of the Philippines (DMAP), this year’s convention carries the theme “Interoperability: Welcome to the Age of Collaboration,” challenging businesses to break down silos, connect capabilities, and harness human creativity alongside emerging technologies. Opening the conference, DigiCon 2026 Co-Chairs Shayne Madamba and Raymund Sison joined DMAP President Miko David in underscoring the need for greater collaboration across industries. “Interoperability.
